Make tonal package namespace lazy so tonal.notes skips music21/mido

tonal/__init__.py now resolves its public names (and the chords,
converters, notes, util submodules) on first access via a PEP 562
module __getattr__ with an explicit name -> submodule map, plus __dir__
and __all__. `import tonal.notes` no longer imports music21 or mido.

Adds tests asserting every previously exposed name still resolves
(attribute access, from-import, star-import) and that importing
tonal.notes leaves music21 and mido out of sys.modules.

Closes #11
